content:
You plan to visit 5 European cities for 21 days in total. You only take direct flights to commute between cities. You want to spend 7 days in Reykjavik. You plan to stay in Riga for 2 days. You want to meet a friend in Riga between day 1 and day 2. You plan to stay in Warsaw for 3 days. You plan to stay in Istanbul for 6 days. You are going to attend a wedding in Istanbul between day 2 and day 7. You want to spend 7 days in Krakow.

Here are the cities that have direct flights:
Istanbul and Krakow, Warsaw and Reykjavik, Istanbul and Warsaw, Riga and Istanbul, Krakow and Warsaw, Riga and Warsaw.

Find a trip plan of visiting the cities for 21 days by taking direct flights to commute between them.

Please output the trip plan in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"day_range": "Day X-Y", "place": "<CITY>"}]}. Include all city visits with their day ranges. Do not include separate flight entries in the JSON output.

IMPORTANT: When you fly from city A to city B on day X, that day counts for BOTH cities. For example:
- If you stay in Venice from Day 1-3 and fly to Vienna on Day 3, then:
  - Venice: Day 1-3 (3 days)
  - Vienna: Day 3-6 (4 days, including the flight day)
- The flight day (Day 3) is counted for both Venice and Vienna.
- Do NOT create separate flight entries in the JSON.

{
  "itinerary": [
    {"day_range": "Day 1-2", "place": "Riga"},
    {"day_range": "Day 2-7", "place": "Istanbul"},
    {"day_range": "Day 7-13", "place": "Krakow"},
    {"day_range": "Day 13-15", "place": "Warsaw"},
    {"day_range": "Day 15-21", "place": "Reykjavik"}
  ]
} 

Explanation:
• You start in Riga from Day 1 to Day 2 (a 2‐day visit that lets you meet your friend between day 1 and day 2). On Day 2 you take a direct flight (overlapping Day 2) to Istanbul.
• In Istanbul, you spend 6 days from Day 2 to Day 7. Since the wedding must occur between Day 2 and Day 7, it fits into your Istanbul visit.
• On Day 7 you fly (with overlap) from Istanbul to Krakow where you spend 7 days (Day 7–13).
• Then on Day 13 you fly from Krakow to Warsaw (overlap on Day 13) and spend 3 days (Day 13–15).
• Finally, on Day 15 you fly from Warsaw to Reykjavik (overlap on Day 15) and finish with 7 days in Reykjavik (Day 15–21), fulfilling the 7‐day requirement there.
The chosen direct flights (Riga–Istanbul, Istanbul–Krakow, Krakow–Warsaw, Warsaw–Reykjavik) all exist according to the provided list, and the overlapping flight days ensure that the total trip length comes to 21 days.
